messages:
talia (People Ops): Quick note Arjun K. is dropping off a giant sunflower arrangement + an oversized poster tube tomorrow at 9:30 for a 10:00 meeting. Courier ETA 9:15. Can someone meet them, grab a dolly, and make a badge? He asked for step-free access and a low stool. Also: do not leave the poster tube leaning in the main stairwell please.

ben: I can cover 9:109:40 at the desk and have a folding dolly in locker 4. Will meet courier. :sunflower: :truck:

frontdesk-bot: Visitor pre-registration: Arjun K. ID uploaded, vehicle plate LMO-555, courier tracking #PT12345. Please add to deliveries sheet.

mailroom: If the poster is rolled art, tag as "DO NOT FOLD" and store in Tube Rack D4. Flowers go on hospitality shelf in a small vase, not near vents. Add notes to https://redwood-internal/deliveries.

facilities: Dolly and extra straps will be at lobby by 9:00. We'll also bring a small step-free ramp for the loading dock if needed.

visitor: Arjun K.: Thanks team! I'll try to be there ~9:20. Poster tube is 36" long, fragile prints inside. Appreciate the low stool and window seat if possible.

ben: Badge printed as "Guest: Arjun K." + Wi-Fi card (RedwoodGuest_2026). Reserved the two-seat sofa by the west windows. Will move tube to D4 after check-in and label "DO NOT FOLD".

talia (People Ops): Perfect thanks everyone. Reminder: log any delivery damage in the sheet and ping me if courier leaves unsigned. Also quick seating poll for the visitor: sofa / high-top / desk 5? Sofa seems best. :thumbsup:
